headline: Stale: a commentary piece on a CFO change CRISPR announced on Oct 20
reasoning: The item (Benzinga 16:01 UTC) comes from a Barchart opinion piece: 'The Outlook of CRISPR Therapeutics Stock Does Not Look Strong After Its CFO Resigns'. Quoted summary: 'CRISPR Therapeutics AG reported the resignation of its Chief Financial Officer.'
The change was public on Oct 20: 'CRISPR Therapeutics Appoints A. J. Silver CFO, Effective Immediately, Succeeding Raju Pras...' (Benzinga, Oct 20 evening). Three sessions have traded it.
Price: CRSP 49.165, -1.6% on the day, flat across the week.
objections: Stale: a commentary rewrite of an Oct 20 announcement.
